Owl Totem
The Wise-Wing Owls, who serve Jhunal the Rune God, may have once sought to understand the hearts of mortals. Nonetheless, they never grew truly close to them, for they knew that affection could only lead mortals astray. Yet even though belief in them eventually faded, their love for mortals never did.

Bloody Grudge-Roots
Memories flow through blood. Blood by its very nature rejects the sea, and so it takes root, as if clinging on. Follow the example of Mnemo-Li the Mosquito Goddess, and suck on the taint of blood. For a grudge can never be absolved through another grudge.

Mnemolichite Maid
The tale of that maiden to first hold the star-minerals of heaven. Even now the nameless writers of Nahd gather around the Drowned Lamp in the desert of the deep sea, weaving their tales. Perhaps we, too, are merely another of the stories they tell.

Snow Prince Idol
The Snow Prince walks upon the words. Thus, the invaders from Atmora burned all the books and wiped out all the storytellers. And even so, the Snow Prince yet wanders through the people's imagination. There lies a memory that would not be forgotten.
